themes.label: Hawkish Fed Policy Error → Curve Flattening
themes.stance: 10Y–2Y at 0.27 (from 0.40 at start of cycle), 10Y–3M at 0.63; the 2Y at 4.20% is pricing ~57bp of net tightening into Warsh's Jun 24–25 debut despite two consecutive benign core prints. May housing starts at a 10-month low confirm the rate-sensitive crack. Tactical ZROZ add valid but entry is into-strength post-FOMC, not chase — hawkish-hold surprise could push 2Y higher first.
themes.tell: July 14 core CPI <0.25% MoM + further 10Y–2Y compression confirms the policy-error/disinflation read. Core CPI ≥0.30% MoM vindicates the hike camp and kills the trade. 10Y breaking >4.75% on August refunding supply indigestion flips duration from long to defensive.

themes.label: Iran Deal → Oil Collapse → Disinflation
themes.stance: WTI at $84.65 (–15% in two weeks); oil slipped further on US–Iran talks progress despite Trump Hormuz threats — channel transmitting. Netanyahu-out-by-2026 odds fell sharply to 53.5% from 63.5%, signaling rising deal fragility. Disinflation is the base case; small Hormuz-snapback energy hedge is the cheap asymmetric tail. TIPS trim warranted as headline CPI distortion mechanically reverses.
themes.tell: WTI sustained sub-$90 through Jun 26 PCE and July 14 CPI validates the channel. Confirmed Iran-talks collapse or OPEC+ surprise cut snapping WTI above $100 negates it. July 14 headline and core CPI are the clean adjudication.

themes.label: Asset Euphoria vs. Collapsing Consumer Confidence
themes.stance: May retail +0.88% MoM nominal (~+0.4% real even on the hot headline deflator) suggests real spending is holding better than sentiment implies — modestly constructive. But Michigan at 49.8 (vs. 56.6 in Feb) and housing starts at a 10-month low keep consumer discretionary neutral, not overweight. Gap is partially — not fully — closed.
themes.tell: A second consecutive positive real retail print (June data) confirms the consumer turn and could warrant discretionary overweight. Michigan sentiment below 47 or a negative June retail print re-opens the gap. A second weak housing starts print signals rate sensitivity spreading.

themes.label: Secular Defense Rearmament Bid
themes.stance: Bid is broadening and deepening: German/French governments taking equal stakes in tankmaker KNDS, Australia–Canada $1.75B Arctic radar deal, Ukraine's deepest drone strike yet (~2,000km) hits a Russian oil refinery with no settlement in sight. New wrinkle: China rare-earth export curbs on US defense primes create an input-cost overhang — pair XAR overweight with ex-China rare-earth (MP Materials) to hedge the supply leg.
themes.tell: NATO/EU defense budget commitments rising above 2.5% GDP targets or further US/allied defense spending confirms. China rare-earth restrictions tightening further pressures prime margins — watch for guidance cuts at defense primes in earnings. A comprehensive Ukraine peace settlement is the key structural refutation.

themes.label: AI Export-Control Fragmentation Overhang
themes.stance: Fragmentation is now intersecting with the China rare-earth retaliation channel: AI/tech hardware supply chains face both access restrictions (Anthropic/Mythos ban, allied friction) and input-cost pressure from China export curbs. TAM overhang on megacap tech intact into late-July earnings. Stay light QQQ. AI for Good Summit (Jul 7–10) is a near-term policy headline risk.
themes.tell: MSFT/GOOGL/AAPL late-July capex guidance sustaining or raising spend confirms durability despite the access overhang. Further allied-country friction, additional model/chip export bans, or rare-earth-related guidance cuts from semis confirm structural fragmentation. NVIDIA Q2 FY27 (late Aug) is the demand-confirmation gate.

themes.label: Divided Government → Fiscal Gridlock & Supply Risk
themes.stance: Dem House ~80%, R Senate ~58% — gridlock thesis intact into Sept 30 FY27 funding cliff. Early-August Treasury quarterly refunding is the near-term long-end supply risk and the binding cap on the tactical duration add. Supreme Court term-end rulings (by Jun 30) add sector-specific dispersion risk.
themes.tell: Early-August Treasury refunding announcement size and 10Y/30Y auction tail; 10Y breaking >4.75% on supply indigestion confirms long-end risk. Sept 30 government funding deadline is the gridlock crystallization event.

themes.label: Core Inflation Trajectory — Benign or Re-Accelerating
themes.stance: Core CPI +0.21% MoM May (after +0.38% April) and core PCE +0.24% April are two consecutive benign prints. Hot headline (+0.47% May) is purely the war-energy spike now mechanically reversing as oil collapses. Warsh is fighting a fading enemy. June 26 core PCE and July 14 CPI are the next adjudication gates. TIPS trim warranted as breakevens compress.
themes.tell: July 14 core CPI sub-0.25% MoM confirms the downtrend and frames Warsh as too hawkish. A +0.30%+ MoM read vindicates the hike camp and undercuts the long-duration add. June 26 core PCE is the parallel gate.

themes.label: BOJ Tightening → Yen Carry Unwind Risk
themes.stance: BOJ at 1% (31-year high); broad USD firm (~119.5) on Warsh hawkishness and dollar call-option demand, providing a partial offset to carry-unwind — but positioning risk accumulating. Firm USD is a near-term headwind for gold (IAU neutral), EM, and commodities. Trim JPY-funded crowded longs.
themes.tell: USDJPY breaking sharply lower through ~142 is the carry-unwind trigger; watch for correlated selloffs in high-beta risk assets on JPY strength. A BOJ pause or dovish communication at the next meeting would delay the risk.
